newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Feb 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Feb 6.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Aftershock jolts Iran as quake death toll hits 72.
- Tehran nears showdown with United States. Oil investors in Iran risk Washington wrath.
- Britain's Marks & Spencer to open first store in Gulf.
- The United States and Qatar plan joint military exercises.
- Clinton stresses U.S. leading role in global peacemaking.
- Saudi real GDP rise seen at two percent in 1997.
- Abu Dhabi National Oil Company planning big expansion at Habshan gas plant.
